integrity: Analytic inequalities and a singular-perturbation comparison prove the claim; accompanying code supplies numerical sanity checks only. No claim of external certification or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The proved limit is for the normalized Gaussian SfIR ordinary differential equations with diffusion-independent strictly positive susceptible and infected seeds. It does not establish convergence of the parent Fokker--Planck PDE or simultaneous large-time/large-diffusion limits. Finite numerical experiments support but do not prove the asymptotics.
title: A sharp fast-social-diffusion boundary layer and surviving infection in the Gaussian epidemic model
